card.name: Endings of foreign place and proper names
card.fires_on: Final piece of a long proper name or foreign-language word, often a Slavic place name or a Cyrillic/Polish/Slovene term in a reference-style passage. It weakly fires on a few other word endings such as neutropenia.

modes.label: Slavic place-name endings
modes.description: Last piece of a Russian, Slovene or Polish place or institution name.

modes.label: Other word endings
modes.description: Final piece of a medical or titled word, such as a condition or church title.

card.plain: It marks the last piece of a long foreign name or word, mostly Slavic place names, with weak hits on a few medical words.
